runtime_gates.immediate_denial: RuntimeConfig.market_rights_enabled defaults false; DenyByDefaultPolicy returns rights_pending before client creation or network access. This is a conservative prototype configuration, not evidence that KIS prohibits an individual own-account local quote.
runtime_gates.personal_use_basis: KIS Open API introduction says an individual account holder may use quote information only for investment in their own assets and may not provide it to third parties. KIS provider page distinguishes individual self-use from corporate third-party partnership; the partner-branded exchange agreement notice is framed for partner institutions.
runtime_gates.personal_use_limits: The official pages support the narrow individual own-asset use category but do not decide local report retention, derived outputs, active ChatGPT Work/model-host egress, or a multi-user student plugin distributed for per-user execution. External sharing remains disabled.
runtime_gates.next_runtime_blocker: The project-local profile file has not been configured and no Keychain lookup was run. main() now reads only the non-secret profile reference from .goose/moai-stock/kis-profile.json; market_rights_enabled remains false and blocks before credential lookup. If rights are separately enabled in a later approved runtime, a missing profile would return credential_missing before KIS.
runtime_gates.single_user_local_quote_preconditions: user-owned KIS Open API profile; explicit local non-secret credential_profile_ref; two OS Keychain records matching the fixed service names; active host data-result route reviewed; no external share. Do not request generic written partner clearance for this narrow case solely from rights_pending.
runtime_gates.higher_distribution_scope: Before a student multi-user product or third-party displayed service is enabled, resolve whether per-user local calls and ChatGPT model-host result flow remain within KIS personal-use terms; do not expose pooled data, public quote feeds, or third-party redistribution.
runtime_gates.no_secret_rule: No secret in chat, MCP args, .goose, report, environment variables, command line, or logs. .goose may hold a non-secret profile reference only.
runtime_gates.rights_status_output: server responses use rights_status=pending unless a purpose-specific rights basis is implemented; technical policy allow is not provider approval

credential_profile.status: configuration bridge implemented; no local profile file configured; no Keychain lookup performed; no active provider connection
credential_profile.current_adapter: macOS KeychainCredentialProvider, read-only lookup only; it cannot create or update items
credential_profile.keychain_account: the same opaque credential_profile_ref supplied by project config; no reference is set in current project
credential_profile.secret_contents: KIS App Key in the first named generic-password item; KIS App Secret in the second. No account number or account product code is used by the market quote tool.
credential_profile.data_path: local process reads the two Keychain values into memory; KIS OAuth client_credentials POST and allowlisted quote GET go directly to the official KIS endpoint; the KIS response is normalized in the local process; tool structuredContent returns to the active ChatGPT Work/model host. MoAI receives no financial payload by design.
credential_profile.persistence: App Key and App Secret persist only in user OS Keychain if separately entered by the user; .goose stores only profile ref; access tokens and App Key/Secret runtime references are memory-only and cleared on client close; app writes no credentials
credential_profile.recipient_scope: KIS receives credential data and request headers; local MCP runtime receives the market response; active model host receives tool output when invoked; MoAI authorization server does not receive it.
credential_profile.future_user_action: After the separate action approval, set the project-local non-secret profile reference and create both generic-password entries directly in macOS Keychain Access using the exact service names and same account label. Never paste the values into chat or the project.
credential_profile.profile_config_file: .goose/moai-stock/kis-profile.json relative to the server current working project root; app does not create it or search other locations
credential_profile.profile_config_behavior: missing file preserves deny-by-default; malformed, duplicate-key, symlinked, oversized or extra-field file fails with invalid_config; config cannot enable market rights or account access

personal_use_rights_review.interpretation: rights_pending is a conservative prototype setting; official public guidance supports an individual account holder using quote data for their own-asset investment and prohibits third-party provision. personal_use_rights_review.no_extra_blanket_approval: do not require generic written partner approval for this narrow individual local use solely because the flag is false; do not clear the flag globally or enable export/share.
